message.content:
A classic lasagna typically includes these ingredients:

| Category | Typical Items |
|----------|---------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | 12–15 sheets (regular or no‑boil) |
| **Meat sauce** | 1 lb ground beef or a mix of beef & pork; 1 onion, 2–3 cloves garlic, 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce, 1 can (6 oz) tomato paste, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp dried basil, salt & pepper |
| **Ricotta mixture** | 15 oz ricotta cheese, 1 egg, ½ cup grated Parmesan, pinch of nutmeg, salt & pepper |
| **Mozzarella** | 2–3 cups shredded mozzarella (or sliced) |
| **Parmesan** | ½–¾ cup grated (for topping) |
| **Optional extras** | 1 cup shredded mozzarella or provolone; ½ cup chopped spinach or sautéed mushrooms; 1 tbsp fresh basil or parsley; 1 tsp red‑pepper flakes for heat |

**Basic assembly steps**

1. Cook noodles until al dente, drain, and lay flat on a sheet of parchment or lightly oiled baking sheet.  
2. Prepare the meat sauce: sauté onion & garlic, add ground meat until browned, stir in tomatoes, paste, herbs, and seasonings; simmer 20–30 min.  
3. Mix ricotta with egg, Parmesan, nutmeg, salt, and pepper.  
4. In a baking dish, spread a thin layer of sauce, then a layer of noodles, ricotta mixture, mozzarella, and repeat until all layers are used, finishing with mozzarella and Parmesan on top.  
5. Cover with foil and bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden.  
6. Let rest 10 min before slicing.

Feel free to tweak the ratios or add veggies to suit your taste!
